title: Great tour!!! We got to see big...
text: Great tour!!! We got to see big parts of the city and very beautiful parts. Our tour guide was great and took pictures for us and let us stop at each stop and gave us time to digest the surroundings and take pictures and ask her questions. I have done bike tours before where we are just always on the bike and its a quick stop and go and I missed opportunities to take pictures and digest the surroundings so I was skeptical when I booked this, but this was the best bike tour I have done yet!
